result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the notification badge in the top-right corner is a floating red dot detached from any visible icon, and a category chip is clipped at the right edge (expected carousel behavior, not reported). One minor visual defect: the profile/notification button appears as an empty gray circle with only a small red dot, missing its icon.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner (next to the delivery address) renders as an empty light-gray circle with only a small red notification dot; the underlying icon (e.g., profile or bell icon) is missing, leaving the control looking broken and unlabeled.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon (profile/bell) inside the circular button and anchor the red badge to the icon's corner so the control is recognizable and tappable with clear affordance.

issues.description: The red notification badge on the top-right circular button is very small and has no visible count or label, and the button itself has low contrast against the light background, making its purpose unclear.
issues.suggestion: Increase badge size or include a count, ensure the button icon meets contrast guidelines, and add an accessibility label such as 'Notifications'.
